name: Phaerimm Hatchling
languages: telepathy 30 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The phaerimm has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phaerimm makes two Stinger attacks.
Phaerimm zealously guard their rare hatchlings not out of parental devotion, but to ensure their kind's growing strength.
